body: Hi, try with a wrapper shell script, something like this: ```bash #!/bin/sh /usr/bin/flatpak run --branch=stable --arch=x86_64 --command=gimp-3.0 --file-forwarding org.gimp.GIMP "$1" ``` If you call the script e.g. `photogimp.sh`, then simply specify its path in the preferences (and make sure that the script is actually executable): HTH
